prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: L0 master character reference sheet for a cel-animated music video, landscape 16:9.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative character and EXACT outfit reference, user-supplied full illustration of Lishenna (Shadowverse, Diva outfit). Images 2 and 3 are STYLE ONLY references from the existing MV, not additional characters or outfits.
Primary request: A faithful model sheet of this same pink-haired idol, on plain warm ivory paper background. Arrange three complete standing full-body views across the left three quarters: FRONT, true LEFT SIDE (her nose points toward the left edge of the canvas), and BACK. Place a larger front-facing head-and-shoulders close-up in the right quarter, including both floating speaker discs. NO captions, letters, labels, numbers or watermark. The three full-body figures have identical scale, the top of the hair and soles aligned to common horizontal baselines. Entire shoes and hair ornaments in frame with comfortable margin.
Character likeness: long coral-pink hair extending past the waist with straight fine bangs and side locks, blue-violet eyes, small confident playful smile, black-and-white checker-pattern hairband and two black decorative rabbit-ear-like loops. Two separate gold-rimmed round floating speaker discs, one beside each side of her head, with dark faces and cyan abstract ornamental sigils, matching Image 1. Consistent facial design and hair length in all views.
Outfit MUST reproduce Image 1, not a variant: oversized white off-the-shoulder jacket with very puffy sleeves and cyan shoulder accents, bare shoulder openings exactly as the reference; opaque sleeveless white top, black high neck collar, cyan neck bow plus cyan necktie; black high-waisted SHORTS (not a skirt), black suspender straps with ornate silver buckle; opaque black thigh-high socks; chunky WHITE sneakers with purple crisscross laces, small yellow accents and cyan sole trim. Natural bare hands, no gloves. Keep the covered torso and the same clothing construction in all views, including side and back; do not invent exposed chest, lingerie, bodysuit or alternate costume. Hidden back details should be conservative consistent continuations of the jacket and shorts.
Pose: relaxed neutral standing, feet planted, both arms hang naturally at sides, hands relaxed, no microphone. Eye-level orthographic-like camera, upright figure, no foreshortening or low angles. Fully clothed and nonsexual presentation.
Style/medium: match existing MV Images 2 and 3: clean fine anime line art, crisp outlines, flat cel shading with a little soft secondary shadow, gently warm restrained palette. Keep original character outfit colors including cyan accents. Neutral even lighting, not glossy painted card-art; remove all neon city lighting.
Constraints: only Lishenna, her two head ornaments, and two speaker discs per depiction. No winged familiars, animals, Ralmia, robots, background scenery, props, holograms, card frames or game UI. No redesign. No visible text or logo; speaker sigils are nonalphabetic ornament. Plain opaque ivory background.
review: Generated three full-body views at consistent height plus front close-up; checked outfit, bare hands, long coral hair, cyan bow and tie, thigh-high socks and sneakers. User confirmation required before L1-L6; remaining seven assets not generated.
